question: Should OpenClaw add native context-pressure escalation for child/subagent sessions, and if so should it be an observe-only alert, a parent-session handoff, or automatic recovery/rerouting?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds policy and possibly config surface across session health, parent routing, operator notifications, and recovery behavior; automation should not choose those semantics.

options.title: Define observe-first alerts
options.body: Add a native context-pressure signal that alerts the parent/operator through existing session/task surfaces before adding automatic recovery behavior.

options.title: Limit to status/diagnostics
options.body: Keep context pressure as inspectable status/health data and require operators or plugins to decide recovery policy outside core.

options.title: Defer as orchestration framework
options.body: Reject parent recovery/rerouting until there is a broader maintainer-approved multi-agent orchestration design.

recommendation.title: Define observe-first alerts
recommendation.body: Add a native context-pressure signal that alerts the parent/operator through existing session/task surfaces before adding automatic recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses session diagnostics and product guardrails, and current-main blame plus repository guidance make steipete the best available routing owner.
